summary: Red-phase tests-only run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Contract tests, stubbed generated-client tests, generated-types coding tests, and facade tests are committed; they intentionally fail until the ColorMatchingAPI target (swift-openapi-generator + vendored openapi.json) lands in the implementation run. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110) are recorded in docs/openapi-client-migration.md. Swift toolchain is not installed in this container, so the suite could not be executed locally; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, swift test on macOS) is the executor.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document vendored from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.note: Fails at HEAD because Sources/ColorMatchingAPI/openapi.json and the Package.swift dependencies do not exist yet; passes when the vendored document and toolchain dependencies land.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generated client covers manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

verification.note: Compile-red: the ColorMatchingAPI module (generated client) does not exist yet.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models as-is

verification.note: GeneratedTypesCodingTests/APIClientGeneratedSurfaceTests are compile-red until generated types and the receipts/ranked-results/error surface exist; MeasurementCoreTests (client-side models) are deliberately untouched.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses, no live server in CI

verification.note: All stubbing is in-process (SendableTransport stub + URLProtocol stub); no network I/O anywhere in the target.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the real API, and endpoint gaps

verification.note: 14 documented deltas/gaps including under-declared manifest and ranked-results components, printer_profile shape drift, relative manifest_url, 201/200+JSON responses, required normalized_linear_rgb_median, undeclared stats.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exit criterion: swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types wired in

verification.note: Not run: no Swift toolchain in this container and implementation intentionally excluded from this tests-only run; suite executes via CI swift test once the generated client lands.
